name: vortos/vortos-framework
description: The Vortos Clean Architecture Framework — meta-package

suggest.vortos/vortos-persistence-dbal: DBAL write repository — choose this or persistence-orm, not both
suggest.vortos/vortos-persistence-orm: Doctrine ORM write repository — choose this or persistence-dbal, not both
suggest.vortos/vortos-persistence-mongo: MongoDB read repository support — requires ext-mongodb
suggest.vortos/vortos-mcp: MCP server for AI clients — optional development assistant integration
suggest.vortos/vortos-aws-ses: AWS SES email delivery with transactional outbox, suppression lists, webhooks, and observability
suggest.vortos/vortos-push: Web Push notification delivery (VAPID + RFC 8291 aes128gcm) behind a driver-based sender contract
suggest.vortos/vortos-sse: Server-Sent Events realtime signalling (Redis-backed per-channel version + bounded SSE stream helper)
suggest.vortos/vortos-object-store: S3-compatible object storage package with first-class Cloudflare R2 defaults
suggest.vortos/vortos-paddle: Paddle billing integration — subscriptions, webhooks, catalog, and customer management
suggest.vortos/vortos-iac: Terraform (.tf.json) export of framework resource declarations — Kafka topics, object-store buckets
